headline: Executive order renames the President's Committee on Mental Retardation as the President's Committee for People with Intellectual Disabilities.
what_it_does: This order changes Executive Order 12994, which set up a presidential advisory committee on mental retardation. It gives the committee a new name: the President's Committee for People with Intellectual Disabilities. The title says it also makes other amendments to the earlier order, but no details are provided.

who_it_affects.group: Members and staff of the presidential advisory committee
who_it_affects.how: The committee they serve on now has a new official name, and other parts of its founding order may have changed.

who_it_affects.group: People with intellectual disabilities and their families
who_it_affects.how: The federal advisory committee focused on their issues now uses the term "intellectual disabilities" in its name.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed July 25, 2003; the effective date is not stated in the title.
